item.description: Keyboard shortcuts that work from any app: ⌃⌥T opens New Timer and ⌃⌥M opens or closes the mirror. Settings has a new Keyboard shortcuts section with a switch for each. Fixed: ⌃⌥N didn't open the quick note while clipboard history was on. Fixed: with the quick note open, its buttons could slide under the camera; copy and clear now sit in the note's corner.

Polish - The welcome guide covers Claude Code status and Today, and lets you turn on the weather, the System Monitor and clipboard history from the start. - VoiceOver reads Today and the clipboard history more clearly, and announces when you copy an item again. - Tested for 40 minutes with every feature running at once: no leaks, steady memory.

Stays out of the way - The island steps aside while a video, presentation or game is full screen, and comes back when you leave. Notices still appear. Turn it off in Settings › Island.
Clipboard history - Press ⌃⌥V to see the last 12 things you copied, and click one to copy it again. Kept in memory only, never saved; passwords are never recorded. Turn it on in Settings › Activities › Clipboard.
Make it yours - An outline around the island, in a colour you choose. - A soft glow in the album's colour while music plays. - Size presets, and a choice of what shows beside the camera when several things are live.
